inputs.generator: make_cases.py (seeded synthetic PSDs); run_reference.m (vFLIP2.m and its public copy)

encoding: psd rows as JSON numbers, each the float's repr; NaN rows as null
selection: greedy over the categories accepted_upright, accepted_inverted, below_cut, no_window, input_upright, input_inverted, input_both, both_input_inverted_best, nan_edge, bin_0.5, bin_1.0, bin_2.0, kind_noise; each takes the candidate with the fewest psd values
